title: Research evaluation with ChatGPT: Is it age, country, length, or field biased?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing ChatGPT quality evaluation scores for journal articles across different publication years (2003, 2008, 2013, 2018, and 2023) using ordinary least squares regression to determine if older articles receive systematically lower scores.
Comparing average ChatGPT quality evaluation scores assigned to journal articles across 26 different Scopus subject categories to identify systematic disciplinary differences.
Calculating Pearson correlations and performing regression analysis between the combined character length (and log-length) of an article's title and abstract and its assigned ChatGPT score.

Using binary-coded variables for the first author's country of affiliation (focusing on the top ten publishing countries) in a regression model to test for systematic scoring advantages or disadvantages based on country or language.
